mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the dearth in creativity and originality on the part of African scholarship (Chimakonam 2019, 163)."
The implication is the dearth in creativity and originality on the part of African scholarship (Chimakonam 2019, 163).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means different things to different people and thus it has been used in several ways in literatures (Lawal, 2006: 66)."
Globalisation means different things to different people and thus it has been used in several ways in literatures (Lawal, 2006: 66).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the total way of life of a people in their attempt to harness and conquer their environment."
Culture is the total way of life of a people in their attempt to harness and conquer their environment.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process whereby the "Other" is treated with deference, courtesy and compassion in an endeavor to safeguard the integrity, dignity, value and social worth of the individual."
Respect is the process whereby the "Other" is treated with deference, courtesy and compassion in an endeavor to safeguard the integrity, dignity, value and social worth of the individual.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the gridlocks serving as the failure to appreciate African ethnoscientific reflections."
Western science is one of the gridlocks serving as the failure to appreciate African ethnoscientific reflections.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known for asking more questions than providing answers to such questions."
Socrates is known for asking more questions than providing answers to such questions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means "A causes B" in both contexts (Afisi, 2016: 66)."
Causality still simply means "A causes B" in both contexts (Afisi, 2016: 66).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the main agenda of this section."
Attempting to answer these questions is the main agenda of this section.
